findings.problem: The Spanish card valer-be-worth (to be worth) has the same meaning as German wert (sein), so its picture fits this card.

back.target: worth (predicative adjective, used with sein: etwas wert sein = to be worth something)
back.example: The old car isn't worth much.

note: The noun der Wert (value) is a separate word, and the lowercase adjective target with its example keeps this card clear of it.
